event.canonical_title: Apple Set to Reveal Folding iPhone at Upcoming Launch Event
event.summary: Apple is anticipated to unveil a new folding iPhone during its annual launch event on Wednesday at its Cupertino headquarters. This represents a significant update to its smartphone design, with expectations of a premium price point for the new device.
